# kion_idms_group_association (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion IdmsGroupAssociation by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_idms_group_association" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the IdmsGroupAssociation to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `assertion_name` (String)
- `assertion_regex` (String)
- `idms_id` (Number)
- `user_group_id` (Number)
